text:
emily: Quick heads-up: midweek quiet window tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. Were prioritizing two low-risk changes: routing-policy:v2 and quant-tuner:v1.3. Full release-freeze for the main train during the window, but we will allow ops-verified canaries. See plan: https://go.redwood/midweek-quiet :calendar:

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: start=2026-04-02T02:00:00Z end=2026-04-02T05:00:00Z. Canary windows enabled: routing-policy:v2 @ 02:10 UTC (3% eu-west), quant-tuner:v1.3 @ 02:30 UTC (2% us-east). Auto-rollout=false.

oncall-ops: Oncall will monitor both canaries. Page thresholds: error_rate > 0.04 OR latency_p95 +1s over baseline. We'll also watch tokenization mismatches after quant flips.

jim: Are dedicated pools included? We have two customers with pinned infra that might be affected.

emily: Dedicated pools are excluded by default. To opt-in, owners must add a post in #release-exempt by EOD and coordinate with infra. Liaison team will confirm.

nina: Whats the rollback policy for routing-policy?v2?

emily: Hard rollback triggers: any increase in 5xxs >50% sustained for 3m OR routing misassignments >0.2% seen in tracing. Soft rollback: latency_p95 >25% above baseline for 5m -> pause expansion. Manual rollback for correctness issues.

platform-bot: Canary config:```json
{"name":"routing-policy:v2","start":"2026-04-02T02:10:00Z","regions":[{"r":"eu-west","pct":3}],"monitors":["routing_mismatch_pct","error_rate","latency_p95"]}
```

lia: I'll post a short customer outreach note for the two pinned accounts and schedule a quick call if they opt-in.

oncall-ops: We'll enable additional trace sampling during the canaries. Heads-up: increased tracing can add ~2-3% CPU on routing service.

jim: thanks. also adding smoke tests to verify model assignment and request headers.

emily: good. After 20m stable in the primary canary we'll expand routing-policy:v2 to 15% in eu and hold quant-tuner until routing is stable.

deploy-bot: Canary started: routing-policy:v2 eu-west at 2026-04-02T02:10:12Z initial_pct=3.

oncall-ops: Observed a small uptick in routing_mismatch_pct to 0.18% for ~3m, baseline 0.03%. Not past rollback threshold but holding expansion.

emily: hold expansion and investigate. Nina, lia, can you grab traces for the mismatch windows?

nina: grabbing traces now, sending short link.

platform-bot: routing mismatch investigation: root cause hypothesis -> header normalization change in v2. Patch candidate queued.

lia: we validated header normalization patch in staging, looks safe. Suggest patch rollout to canary immediately.

emily: agree. apply patch to routing-policy:v2 in canary, keep canary pct at 3% until we confirm.

deploy-bot: Patch applied to canary at 2026-04-02T02:45:00Z.

oncall-ops: mismatch dropped to 0.04% within 4m after patch. CPU stable.

emily: good. proceed to expand routing-policy:v2 to 15% in eu at +30m. Quant-tuner remains paused until routing is stable and we've passed 45m.

jim: updating runbook with the patch steps and signals watched.

emily: lifting partial freeze for low-risk docs and infra cleanup at 03:00 UTC. Full train freeze lifted at 05:00 UTC as scheduled. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. Will post a short summary in #weekly-release-summary and attach the investigation notes. :white_check_mark:

oncall-ops: No pages during expansion. Final canary status: routing-policy:v2 SUCCESS, duration=02:20, final_mismatch=0.03%.

deploy-bot: Maintenance window completed at 2026-04-02T05:00:10Z.

emily: Reminder: if any teams want the raw metric dumps or extra traces, ping me directly. We'll follow up with a short blameless writeup tomorrow.
